defects.title: Blinding glowing white rectangular obstruction at vehicle spawn
defects.root_cause: Vertical QuadMesh oriented in local XY plane with Basis(right, norm, -fwd) and overbright 5.5 emission shader on dense sample indices 1 & 3 standing directly in front of car bumper
defects.resolution: Replaced QuadMesh with horizontal PlaneMesh aligned flush with track surface (norm * 0.04), directional animated energy chevrons, trigger area with speed impulse, and spawn clearance >=15m

defects.title: Off-track tumbling and infinite falling / reset loop
defects.root_cause: Enforced global_position.distance_to(last_safe_checkpoint_pos) > 65.0 aborting intentional 50m aerial jump gaps; lack of respawn grace cooldown causing recursive fall triggers
defects.resolution: Removed 65m ground threshold, instituted true kill-floor (-30m below track), 6.2s prolonged tumble limit, and 2.5s recovery grace period with forward velocity restore

defects.title: Excessive bloom and unreadable track surfaces
defects.root_cause: glow_bloom set to 0.08 and glow_intensity to 0.40 causing whiteouts on luminous materials; ambient sky under-energized
defects.resolution: Tuned bloom to 0.03, intensity to 0.22, balanced ambient sky energy to 1.15, readable roadway and island silhouettes

defects.title: Miniature buildings and vehicle off-road drift
defects.root_cause: Residential buildings scaled to 3.2m (smaller than player car) and low 10cm curbs allowing drifting into void space
defects.resolution: Replaced miniature buildings with full-scale 56-90m commercial and skyscraper models; raised curbs; instant camera realignment on reset

defects.title: Atomic bidirectional color swap and mission delivery completion
defects.root_cause: Proximity detection (<8m) and relative speed threshold required atomic state transfer without color cloning
defects.resolution: Validated atomic exchange in mission solvability unit tests, traffic pathfinding, and delivery checkpoint scoring

defects.title: Standalone game packages and cross-platform distribution
defects.root_cause: Monorepo previously required suite launcher to execute individual games
defects.resolution: Built 30 standalone packages for 10 games + 4 suite packages with asset isolation and independent entry scenes
